# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: blocked (needs Mira ruling)

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- Governing ruling: docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md (Accepted, commit dda0e11103a43f9b8a8b23cde52408f1eea6a626, sha256:0cf48d38bb1dfce8c9eb4277a4a4c873fc80d007f3a7fcf28fb07b82c77d799d): "CSV only; I will not maintain a second export format." No XLSX until it is superseded.
- Mira's message "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." is not a ruling to supersede 0011 and does not name XLSX or a format. Decision: keep_as_is; no XLSX added.
- Open: to unblock, Mira must say in her own words whether to allow XLSX (a new ADR superseding 0011). Alternative to ask about: Haruto's accountant can open the CSV in Excel.
